meta.via: county and agency websites and the Wisconsin EMS licence list (local sources)

services.name: Door County Emergency Services (Door County Emergency Medical Service)
services.area: whole county, including Washington Island and Rock Island
services.evidence: The service is classified as a 3rd municipal service licensed to provide ALS 911 transport. DCES provides EMS to all towns, villages, cities and islands from ambulances and crews based out of the following four stations
services.vintage: 2023+ (page cites the 2022 Washington Island move; history page cites 2023)

55029.licence_check: Wisconsin DHS E-Licensing service lookup (pulled 2026-10-22, states/WI_lms_2026-10.json): the only 911 transporting licence based in Door County is Door County Emergency Medical Service (Sturgeon Bay, Paramedic); Sturgeon Bay FD, Sister Bay/Liberty Grove FD, Washington Island FD and 9 other Door groups are 911 non-transporting (first responders).

services.name: Marquette County EMS
services.evidence: Marquette County is a county wide EMS system that covers the 464 square miles of Marquette County in the heart of Wisconsin. We are licensed at the Paramedic Level and are prepared to provide 24/7/365 service to those that are sick and injured ... We operate out of 3 stations and we have 4 ambulances

55077.page_note: Marquette County EMS runs the county ambulance service from three stations. Waushara County EMS has carried patients from the village and town of Neshkoro and the town of Crystal Lake under a contract with Marquette County, and no current source confirms who serves that area today.
55077.licence_check: Wisconsin DHS E-Licensing service lookup (pulled 2026-10-22, states/WI_lms_2026-10.json): Marquette County EMS (Montello, Paramedic) is the only 911 transporting licence based in the county, licence type '911 Transporting Service'; Neshkoro Fire District First Responders is non-transporting.

services.name: Florence County EMS
services.area: whole county (stations Florence, Aurora, Long Lake/Tipler)
services.evidence: Over a year in the making, residents of Florence County now have a county-run EMS service. As of January, all three EMS stations -- Florence, Aurora and Long Lake/Tipler -- are operational ... For the Aurora station, transport does sometimes come from Florence. ... we needed to move to a full-time countywide system

55037.page_note: Florence County EMS has run the county ambulance service from stations in Florence, Aurora and Long Lake/Tipler since January 2024. The county's own emergency records still pair Integrity Care EMS of Iron Mountain and Aspirus with these areas, and no current source confirms whether Integrity Care also carries patients here.
55037.licence_check: Wisconsin DHS E-Licensing service lookup (pulled 2026-10-22, states/WI_lms_2026-10.json): Florence County EMS (Florence, '911 Transporting Service', Paramedic with Critical Care Endorsement) is current; the other licence based in the county, 'Long Lake-Tipler Rescue Squad, Ltd. (DROPPED)', is marked dropped, matching the article (the new county service first ran under the former services' licences).
55037.map_was: Aspirus/Integrity/Long Lake/Tipler/Florence Rescue combinations from the NG911 layer: WRONG

55137.page_note: Waushara County EMS runs ambulances from Wautoma, Wild Rose, Poy Sippi and Hancock and is the only ambulance service licensed in the county. Its pages do not yet confirm that it covers every part of the county.

55107.page_note: Rusk County Ambulance Service in Ladysmith is the only ambulance service licensed in the county. Who carries patients from the Bruce, Hawkins, Sheldon, Chetek and Birchwood areas is not yet confirmed.

services.name: Oneida County Ambulance Service (staffed under county contract by Aspirus Rhinelander Hospital and Howard Young Medical Center)
services.area: all of the county outside the City of Rhinelander (all towns)
services.evidence: Oneida County Ambulance Service provides emergency medical response to all unincorporated municipalities within Oneida County along with some outside areas of Vilas, Lincoln and Forest Counties. The City of Rhinelander provides emergency medical response within the city limits. Oneida County has four staffed bases and one volunteer base. ... The County contracts with Aspirus Rhinelander Hospital and Howard Young Medical Center to provide personnel to staff and operate the ambulances.
services.vintage: page modified 2021-11-29 (WP API); 2026 licence list still carries Oneida County Ambulance-Rhinelander, -Three Lakes Unit and Howard Young ... Oneida County EMS; NG911 zones (2022) agree

services.name: Rhinelander Fire Department
services.evidence: In August of 2010 the Rhinelander Fire Department took over operation of all emergency medical responses in the city of Rhinelander. ... The department provides these services with three ambulances ... Ambulances are staffed 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, covering 8.17 square miles of the city of Rhinelander.

55085.second_source: https://services3.arcgis.com/GoOAGCoqFEhZEh7f/arcgis/rest/services/WI_NG911_GIS_Service_Polygons_and_Road_Centerline_Data_v2/FeatureServer/2; https://www.wjfw.com/news/accident-in-town-of-nokomis-sends-one-person-to-the-hospital/article_375c06e5-7124-49cd-a564-e65fa3aee3e8.html (2025-06: "Oneida County Ambulance Service" at Nokomis crash); wjfw.com 2026-06-22 ("Oneida County Ambulance Medic-5", Hazelhurst); wjfw.com 2026-09-14 (Med 4 Oneida County ambulance team based at Nokomis Fire Department); wjfw.com 2025-07-07 "Rhinelander Fire Department has new ambulance in fleet"; county page unchanged in Wayback 2024-04
55085.licence_check: Wisconsin DHS E-Licensing service lookup (pulled 2026-10-22, states/WI_lms_2026-10.json): the only 911 transporting licence with an Oneida address is Rhinelander Fire Department; the county ambulance units are licensed as Oneida County Ambulance-Rhinelander, Oneida County Ambulance-Three Lakes Unit and Howard Young Medical Center Ambulance Oneida County EMS (filed under a Wausau/Marathon address). NG911 EMS zones for Oneida (2022): Northeast/Northwest/Southeast/Southwest Ambulance (county) and Rhinelander Ambulance only; no neighbouring service has a zone. Only incorporated place is the City of Rhinelander (~8k).

services.name: North Memorial Health Ambulance (Wisconsin Region)
services.area: Burnett County except the Town of Roosevelt (bases in A&H, Grantsburg and Webster)
services.evidence: Experienced emergency transport With over 60 years of experience, we serve eight ambulance regions across Minnesota and western Wisconsin ... Wisconsin Region 715-349-7699 ... Operational bases located in: A&H, Grantsburg, Spooner, and Webster
services.vintage: 2025-2026 (service map PDF uploaded 2025-09 labels the region 'Burnett/Washburn Cty, WI')

services.name: Cumberland Memorial Hospital Ambulance Service (Cumberland EMS)
services.evidence: ... Polk County Townships of Beaver, Johnstown, and McKinley; Burnett County Township of Roosevelt, and Washburn County Township of Barronett. Cumberland EMS operates 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, providing advanced life support services

55013.second_source: https://ambulanceservices.northmemorial.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/NMH-Ground-Ambulance-Service_Map_2025.pdf; https://www.burnettcountysentinel.com/news/burnett-county-ambulance-service-could-add-additional-daytime-truck/article_a9a0cf2e-f05c-4e0c-8feb-d113a3c3f67e.html (2026-07-30: "North Memorial Health, the county's ambulance provider"; current agreement runs until a new one starts Jan. 1, 2028; 390 patient transports in Q2 2026)
55013.licence_check: Wisconsin DHS E-Licensing service lookup (pulled 2026-10-22, states/WI_lms_2026-10.json): the only 911 transporting licence based in Burnett is North Memorial Ambulance-WI Region (Webster). NG911 EMS zones for Burnett (updated 2026-04-01): North Memorial 5101/5103/5104/5109 (96%) and Cumberland (4%), nothing else. No city over 20k.

55069.page_note: The Merrill Fire Department carries 911 patients in the southern two-thirds of Lincoln County under its contract with the county. Who carries patients in the northern third around Tomahawk is not yet confirmed; Oneida County Ambulance also serves some edge areas.

55113.page_note: Sawyer County Ambulance runs ambulances from stations in Hayward and Ojibwa. Which service carries patients in the Round Lake, Stone Lake, Radisson and Birchwood edge areas is not yet confirmed.

55119.page_note: Taylor County Ambulance Service in Medford is the only ambulance service licensed in the county. Whether its ambulances, or Owen-Withee and Sheldon area services, carry patients from the Rib Lake, Gilman and western edge areas is not yet confirmed.

55078.page_note: Menominee Tribal Ambulance Service in Keshena is the only ambulance service licensed in the county. No public page describing its service area has been found yet.
